long_biography.plain_text:
Founded by his grandfather David and expanded by his father Fayez, the Mouawad jewellery business was already an established family platform when Robert Fayez Mouawad took charge. He moved its headquarters to Geneva in the 1970s, introduced Robergé watches and extended the house's reach across Europe, Asia and North America. His acquisition of major diamonds reinforced its position in the international gem trade.

On 1 January 2010, Mouawad passed management to his sons Fred, Alain and Pascal, who became the company's fourth-generation co-guardians. His own documented portfolio extends beyond jewellery to real estate, including Beirut hotels and residences developed on Bahrain's Reef Island. Since stepping back from management, his wealth has remained associated with fine jewellery alongside gems and property investments.
